title: An Apache Spark master is reachable
summary: The Spark master answers unauthenticated, which lists applications and workers and can be made to submit a job.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and body_contains("activeapps") and body_contains("workers") and body_differs(control)

remediate: Require authentication on the Spark master and keep it off the public internet.
